title: Step 8: an extremal invariant member has singular set equal to its invariance subspace
statement: Let P, n, Q ∈ ℕ, F and sing satisfy (H0), (H1), A.1, A.2, A.3c, A.3(2) and A.3(3) as in the parent theorem. Let d ∈ ℕ be such that every L-invariant ψ ∈ F (ψ(y + λx) = ψ(x) for y ∈ L, λ > 0, x) with sing ψ ≠ ∅ has dim L ≤ d. If φ ∈ F is L-invariant for a d-dimensional linear subspace L and sing φ ≠ ∅, then sing φ = L.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n Q : ℕ) (F : Set (Euclid P → Euclid Q)) (sing : (Euclid P → Euclid Q) → Set (Euclid P)), (∀ φ ∈ F, ∀ ψ ∈ F, (∀ᵐ x ∂μH[(n : ℝ)], φ x = ψ x) → φ = ψ) → (∀ φ ∈ F, LocallyIntegrable φ μH[(n : ℝ)]) → (∀ φ ∈ F, ∀ (y : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → lam < 1 → ‖y‖ ≤ 1 - lam → (fun x => φ (y + lam • x)) ∈ F) → (∀ φ ∈ F, ∀ y : Euclid P, ‖y‖ < 1 → ∀ lams : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 < lams k) → StrictAnti lams → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∃ (sub : ℕ → ℕ) (ψ : Euclid P → Euclid Q), StrictMono sub ∧ ψ ∈ F ∧ (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, f x • φ (y + lams (sub k) • x) ∂μH[(n : ℝ)]) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x • ψ x ∂μH[(n : ℝ)]))) ∧ ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ x, ψ (lam • x) = ψ x) → (∀ φ ∈ F, IsClosed (sing φ)) → (∀ φ ∈ F, ∀ (y : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → lam < 1 → ‖y‖ ≤ 1 - lam → sing (fun x => φ (y + lam • x)) = (fun x => y + lam • x) ⁻¹' sing φ) → (∀ φ ∈ F, ∀ φs : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid Q, (∀ k, φs k ∈ F) → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, f x • φs k x ∂μH[(n : ℝ)]) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x • φ x ∂μH[(n : ℝ)]))) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ k₀, ball (0 : Euclid P) 1 ∩ sing (φs k) ⊆ {x | ∃ z ∈ sing φ, dist x z < ε}) → ∀ d : ℕ, (∀ ψ ∈ F, ∀ L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ x, ψ (y + lam • x) = ψ x) → (sing ψ).Nonempty → Module.finrank ℝ L ≤ d) → ∀ φ ∈ F, ∀ L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ L = d → (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ x, φ (y + lam • x) = φ x) → (sing φ).Nonempty → sing φ = (L : Set (Euclid P))
